newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in stable trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in stable trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday as the domestic market reached equilibrium in supply and demand. Dealers said they expected a stable trend ahead.
The local unit ended at T$27.868 against Tuesday's T$27.865 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$240.5 million.
The domestic market largely ignored the greenback's big slide overseas, dealers said.
"Taiwan dollar's value has reached a stable point, and no major deviation is expected," said one dealer.
A T$27.85-88 range was seen for Thursday.
